rna_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one isolated reusable original scientific illustration component for an RNA-seq computational workflow. Subject: a small fan of three short single-stranded RNA molecules, smooth gently curved backbones with a few simple attached nucleotide shapes. These symbolize RNA sequencing libraries, not a specific measured sequence. One coherent subject only. BioRender-like clean flat vector scientific illustration aesthetic, crisp consistent indigo #2E267C outlines, lavender #9D9CF4 and pale lavender #E9E8FF solid fills, tiny teal #27877F accents. No realistic molecular structure or invented exact nucleotide identities. Horizontal compact composition, all molecules fully visible, generous transparent padding. Genuinely transparent background with alpha. No text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels, frames, plots, watermark, checkerboard pattern, shadows, gradients or 3D. This is original artwork, not a copy of proprietary BioRender assets.
rna_edit_prompt: Edit this RNA illustration. Preserve exactly its three RNA strands and approximate arrangement, palette and silhouette. REMOVE ALL glow, shadows, haze, bloom, soft gradients and background color. Use strictly flat solid uniform fills and crisp indigo outlines. Genuine fully transparent alpha outside the crisp outlines, including spaces between strands. No semitransparent halo at all. The entire exterior must be alpha 0 except antialiased contour pixels. Nucleotide shapes use uniform #9D9CF4, #E9E8FF and #27877F. No text. Scientific flat vector-looking asset. NOT luminous. NOT a dark backdrop.
